DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの列について、お尋ねでしょうか。ご希望をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you asking about this queue? Please tell me what you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 御朱印をお願いしたいです。この列に並べば、お守りも御朱印も同じ所で受けられると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: お守りと御朱印を同じ列で受けられると思い、御朱印を希望すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like a goshuin shrine seal and inscription. I thought joining this queue would let me receive both an amulet and a goshuin at the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought amulets and goshuin were available from the same queue and that you would like a goshuin.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の表示は、お守りのご案内です。御朱印については、別の案内を先に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The current sign is for amulets. Let us first check the separate guidance for goshuin.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ列ではなかったのですね。御朱印帳も持っていないので、その場合にどうお願いできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 列が別だと理解し、御朱印帳がない場合の対応を尋ねたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: So it was a different queue. I do not have a goshuin book either, so I would like to ask how I can request one in that situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the queues are separate and want to ask what is possible without a goshuin book.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お持ちでない場合の対応も、御朱印の担当へ確認してください。今こちらで受付済みになったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please also ask the goshuin staff what they can do if you do not have a book. This does not mean your request has already been accepted here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、この列で順番を取れたとは考えず、御朱印の相談先へ行きます。案内のどの表示を見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 今の列で受付済みと考えず、御朱印の相談先を示す表示を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I will not assume that I have secured a place in this queue; I will go to the goshuin inquiry point. Which part of the guidance should I look for?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not regard yourself as registered in the current queue, and ask which sign identifies the goshuin inquiry point.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの紙に御朱印についての問合せ先が載っています。お守りもご希望でしたら、その用件は別にお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This sheet lists the contact point for goshuin inquiries. If you would also like an amulet, please make that request separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日はまず御朱印の相談をします。帳面がないことと、用意される物があるかを担当へ尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 今日は御朱印の相談を先にし、帳面がないことと用意される物の有無を担当へ聞くと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Today I will first ask about the goshuin. I want to tell the responsible staff member that I have no book and ask whether anything is available for that situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult about goshuin first today and ask the staff about not having a book and whether anything can be provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その二点をお伝えください。ご希望に合う対応があるかを伺ってから、お決めになるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please explain those two points. It would be best to decide after asking whether they can offer something that meets your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 対応を聞いてからお願いします。今のお守りの列には戻らず、こちらの問合せ先で、受付方法も含めて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 対応を聞いてから依頼し、お守りの列でなく示された問合せ先で受付方法を確認すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will make my request after hearing what they can offer. I will not go back to the amulet queue; I will check the application procedure too at the contact point shown here.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will request it after hearing the options and check the reception procedure at the indicated inquiry point rather than the amulet queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの案内をお持ちください。別の用件で並び直す時も、表示をお確かめください。それでは、お気をつけてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please take this guidance sheet. If you join a queue for another purpose, please check the sign again. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 検査の報告をまとめている所ですね。数え方で迷った部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You are putting together the inspection report, correct? Was there anything you were unsure how to count?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この三点を不良の数に入れようとしています。表示が付いているので、不良と決まった物だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 表示付きの三点を不良確定と思い、不良数へ入れようとしていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I am about to include these three items in the defective count. Because they have labels, I thought they had been confirmed as defective.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought three labeled items were confirmed defects and were about to include them in the defective count.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表示に書かれた言葉を見てください。こちらは確認待ちです。最終の判定とは区別して報告しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please look at the wording on the labels. These are awaiting confirmation. Let us distinguish that from a final judgment in the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認待ちを、不良が確定した意味に読んでいました。三点の良否は、私にはまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 確認待ちを不良確定と誤読し、三点の良否はまだ不明だと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I had read “Awaiting confirmation” as meaning they were confirmed defects. I do not yet know whether those three items pass or fail.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you misread “Awaiting confirmation” as confirmed defects and do not yet know whether the three items pass or fail.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その三点を不良確定として報告せず、判定の状態を責任者に確認しましょう。集計は、もう提出しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do not report those three as confirmed defects; let us check their assessment status with the person in charge. Have you already submitted the totals?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ提出していません。下書きには三と書きましたが、報告済みではありません。自分で合格に数え直すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 下書きには三とあるが未提出で、自己判断で合格へ数え直しもしないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not submitted them yet. I wrote three in the draft, but I have not reported it. I will not decide on my own to count them as passed instead either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the draft says three but has not been submitted, and that you will not independently reclassify the items as passed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 下書きの状態も含めて伝えましょう。製品の状態について、実際に見たことと推測したことを分けて説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let us explain the status of the draft as well. Can you describe separately what you actually saw about the products and what you inferred?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私が見たのは確認待ちの表示が三点にあることです。傷や寸法が基準外だったと確認したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 見た事実は三点の確認待ち表示だけで、傷や寸法の基準外を確認したのではないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: What I saw was an “Awaiting confirmation” label on each of three items. I did not confirm that any scratches or dimensions were outside the standards.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only saw three “Awaiting confirmation” labels and did not confirm scratches or dimensions outside the standards.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その事実と、下書きに不良三点と書いた経緯を責任者へ伝えます。判定や正式な集計は、返答を受けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will tell the person in charge that fact and explain how you came to write three defects in the draft. Let us confirm the assessments and official totals after receiving their reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 三点は確認待ちと伝え、不良三点と確定した報告は出しません。どの区分で記録するか責任者に確認してからまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 確認待ち三点として説明し、不良確定の報告をせず区分を責任者へ確認すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will explain that three items are awaiting confirmation and will not submit a report stating that three defects have been confirmed. I will compile it after asking the person in charge which category to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain the three pending items, avoid reporting confirmed defects, and check their recording category with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示と下書きをそのまま示して、ご一緒に確認しましょう。返答までは、この集計を確定しないでおいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Let us show the labels and draft as they are and check together. Please do not finalize these totals until we receive a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 時計をお探しですか。置く場所はお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking for a clock? Have you decided where you will put it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 借りている部屋の机で使います。壁に穴を開けたくないので、この写真のように立てられる時計がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 借家の机で使い壁に穴を開けたくないため、写真のように立つ時計が欲しいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will use it on the desk in my rented room. I do not want to make holes in the wall, so I would like a clock that stands up like the one in this photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a clock that stands like the photo for your rented room's desk because you do not want holes in the wall.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真では後ろの支えも使っていますね。こちらの商品に、そのスタンドが含まれるかを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The photo also uses a support at the back. Let us check whether that stand is included with this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 時計だけで立つと思っていました。値札のセット内容には、スタンドという文字が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 時計だけで立つと思ったが、セット内容にスタンドが見当たらないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought the clock could stand by itself. I cannot find the word “stand” in the contents listed on the price label.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought the clock stood on its own but cannot find a stand in the listed contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの表示ではスタンドは別の品です。支えを足す案と、初めから卓上用の別の時計を比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: According to this label, the stand is a separate item. You can compare adding a support with choosing another clock designed for a tabletop from the start.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 部品を増やさず使いたいので、初めから机に置く時計を見ます。壁掛け用を何かに立て掛ける案はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 部品を足さず使いたいため卓上用を見て、壁掛け用を立て掛ける案をやめると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to use it without adding parts, so I will look at clocks designed to sit on a desk. I will drop the idea of leaning a wall clock against something.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a tabletop clock without additional parts and will not lean a wall clock against something.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、こちらの卓上用もご覧ください。机の上では、大きさや表示の見やすさも比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then please also look at this tabletop model. Would you like to compare its size and how easily the display can be read on your desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。机には本も置くので、小さい方を候補にします。少し離れて見ても、時刻の数字を読み取れるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本のある机向けに小さい候補を選び、離れても時刻が読めるか確かめたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. There will also be books on the desk, so I will consider the smaller one. I would like to check whether I can read the time from a little distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider a smaller clock for a desk with books and want to check whether the time can be read from a distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見本をこちらに置きますので、ご覧ください。必要な付属品と、この品の価格表示も合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will put the sample here for you to look at. Let us also check the necessary accessories and this product's displayed price.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 数字は読み取れました。壁に取り付けずに使う、この卓上用を選びます。付属品と合計額を見てから会計へ進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 数字が読めた卓上用を選び、付属品と合計額を確認して会計へ進みたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I could read the numbers. I will choose this tabletop clock, which I can use without attaching it to the wall. I would like to check the accessories and total cost before going to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you choose the readable tabletop clock and want to check the accessories and total before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの品の内容をお見せします。別売のスタンドとは分けて、ご購入前の確認をこちらで続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I will show you what this product includes. Let us continue the pre-purchase checks here, keeping it separate from the stand sold separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 学習のご相談ですね。どんな場面で聞き返せるようになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: You would like some advice about studying, correct? In what situations would you like to be able to ask for clarification?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 職場で日付の指示を聞き違えます。分かったつもりで返事をしてから、別の日だったと気づくことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 職場の日付指示を聞き違え、分かったつもりで答えた後に違う日と気づくと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I mishear instructions about dates at work. Sometimes I answer thinking I understand and then realize they meant a different day.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mishear dates at work and sometimes realize the day was different after answering as if you understood.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 最近の例を、ご自分の言葉で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you tell me a recent example in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 金曜日までに出してくださいと言われて、金曜日に作業すると思いました。提出の期限だと後から分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 金曜日までに提出を金曜日の作業と誤解し、後で期限と分かった例を伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was told to submit something by Friday, and I thought it meant doing the work on Friday. I later understood that it was the submission deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese an example where you mistook submission by Friday for work on Friday and later realized it was a deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、日付と用件を分けて確かめる練習をしましょう。今の指示なら、どのように聞き返したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then let us practice checking the date and the task separately. How would you like to ask for clarification about that instruction?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 金曜日に作業するのではなく、金曜日までに提出するということですか、と確認したいです。今週か来週かも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 金曜作業ではなく金曜までの提出かを復唱し、今週か来週かも尋ねたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to ask, “Do you mean that I should submit it by Friday, rather than do the work on Friday?” I also want to ask whether it is this week or next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to repeat back whether it means submission by Friday rather than work on Friday, and ask whether it is this week or next week.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その二点を確かめる言い方を練習できます。実際の職場の日付は相手に確認する必要がありますが、今日はどちらから練習しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can practice ways to check those two points. You need to ask the actual person about dates at work, but which would you like to practice first today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず提出する用件を復唱し、その後で何月何日かを尋ねる練習をします。曜日だけで分かったことにしないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 先に提出用件を復唱し次に月日を尋ね、曜日だけで理解したとしない練習を選ぶ。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: First I will repeat back the task of submitting it, then practice asking for the month and day. I do not want to assume I understand from the weekday alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to practice repeating the submission task first and asking for the calendar date next, rather than assuming the weekday alone is enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 順番を決められましたね。次に参加できる日も相談できます。お仕事の予定は、毎週同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: You have decided on the order. We can also discuss when you can attend next. Is your work schedule the same every week?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 毎週は同じではありません。勤務表を見て参加日を相談し、来た回で日付と期限の聞き返しを練習したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 勤務時間が毎週違うため勤務表で参加日を相談し、参加回で日付と期限の聞き返しを練習したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: It is not the same every week. I would like to look at my shift schedule to discuss an attendance date and practice asking about dates and deadlines when I come.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your work schedule varies each week, so you want to arrange attendance using your shift schedule and practice clarifying dates and deadlines during those sessions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。まずは今日、今の例で復唱から練習しましょう。次の参加日は勤務表と案内を見て、あらためてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Let us first practice repeating back today's example. Please consult us again about your next attendance date after checking your shift schedule and the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 免許のご相談ですね。今日は、どのような手続きをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: You would like to ask about a driving license, correct? What procedure are you considering today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 外国で取った免許を持っています。有効期限が近いので、日本の免許の更新と同じ所へ申し込めばよいと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 期限が近い外国免許を持ち、日本免許更新と同じ申込みだと思ったと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have a license obtained abroad. It is about to expire, so I came thinking I should apply at the same place as for renewing a Japanese license.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a foreign license nearing expiry and thought the application was the same as renewing a Japanese license.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 日本の免許を既にお持ちか、外国の免許についての相談かを分けて伺います。日本の免許はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let me distinguish whether you already have a Japanese license or are asking about a foreign license. Do you have a Japanese license?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 日本の免許は持っていません。この外国の免許について相談したいです。更新という言葉を自分で使っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 日本の免許はなく外国免許の相談で、更新という名称は自己判断だったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I do not have a Japanese license. I want to ask about this foreign license. I had called it a renewal on my own assumption.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have no Japanese license, are asking about a foreign one, and used the term “renewal” based on your own assumption.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その状況として担当の相談先を確認します。免許の情報を確認するために、ほかに用意した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will check the appropriate contact point for that situation. Have you prepared anything else to help verify the license information?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 免許と、私が日本語に訳したメモです。自分で作った訳がそのまま使えるとは考えず、必要な翻訳について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 免許と自作の日本語メモを持ち、そのまま使えると思わず必要な翻訳を尋ねたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have the license and notes that I translated into Japanese myself. I do not assume my own translation can be used as it is; I would like to ask what translation is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have the license and your own Japanese notes, do not assume those are acceptable as they are, and want to ask about the required translation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 必要な翻訳や確認資料は担当へお尋ねください。ご本人の滞在などを説明できる資料についても、分かる物を整理できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please ask the responsible staff about the required translation and supporting documents. Can you also organize any documents you have that explain your stays and related circumstances?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手元の旅券と、前に住んでいた時期のメモを分けて持っています。足りるかどうかは分からないので、必要な確認を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 旅券と以前の居住時期のメモを分けて持つが十分か不明で、必要な確認を教えてほしいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have my passport and separate notes about the period when I lived there before. I do not know whether they are sufficient, so I would like you to tell me what checks are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a passport and separate notes about your previous period of residence but do not know whether they suffice and want guidance on the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 資料を示して相談するご希望としてご案内します。担当に相談する方法や、予約の必要性も聞いておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will direct you to someone who can discuss the documents you show. Would you also like to ask how to consult the responsible staff and whether an appointment is needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。どの手続きの相談になるか、必要な資料と予約方法を先に確かめます。免許を持っているだけで、ここで運転できるとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 相談手続き・資料・予約方法を先に確かめ、免許所持だけで当地の運転可と判断しないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. I will first check which procedure I need to ask about, the required documents, and how to book. I will not decide that I can drive here merely because I possess a license.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will first confirm the procedure, documents, and booking method, and will not assume possessing a license alone permits you to drive here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。外国の免許についての相談として、担当窓口の案内をお渡しします。有効性や必要な手続きは、担当の確認を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I will give you the information for the desk handling foreign-license inquiries. Please have the responsible staff confirm its validity and the necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お二人で召し上がるラーメンは、それぞれお決まりになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Have the two of you each decided which ramen you will have?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。同じラーメンを二つですが、私の方だけ少なめにできるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同じラーメン二つで、自分の方だけ少なめにできるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. We would like two of the same ramen, but I want to know whether only mine can be made smaller.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can order two of the same ramen with only your own portion reduced.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お味を薄めにするご希望でしょうか。それとも、ほかの変更ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like a milder flavor, or do you mean another change?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 味ではなく、麺の量を少なくしたいです。友人は普通の量を希望しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 薄味ではなく麺量を減らしたく、友人は普通量だと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I mean fewer noodles, not a change in flavor. My friend would like the regular quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want fewer noodles rather than milder seasoning and that your friend wants the regular quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 麺の量のご希望ですね。この料理はご飯付きのセットもありますが、今回はどちらをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: So it is the quantity of noodles you would like changed. This dish also comes in a set with rice; which option are you considering this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご飯は付けず、二人とも単品にします。私は麺だけを少なくできるか、確認してから注文したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二人ともご飯なしの単品にし、自分の麺量変更を確認後に注文すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will both have the ramen on its own, without rice. I would like to order after checking whether only my noodle quantity can be reduced.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that both orders will be without rice and that you will order after checking the change to your own noodle quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は麺を少なくする対応ができます。少なめの一杯は、ご本人の分ですね。もう一杯の量も改めて伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Today we can reduce the noodle quantity. The smaller portion is for you, correct? Could you also confirm the quantity for the other bowl?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 少なめは私の一杯だけです。友人の一杯は普通の量で、どちらも単品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 少なめは本人の一杯だけで、友人は普通量、どちらも単品と改めて確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Only my bowl should have fewer noodles. My friend's bowl should be the regular quantity, and both are ramen on their own.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm again in Japanese that only your bowl has fewer noodles, your friend's bowl is regular, and neither is a set.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 麺少なめの単品が一杯、普通の単品が一杯ですね。料金は、それぞれこちらの表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: One bowl on its own with fewer noodles, and one regular bowl on its own. Please check each price on this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 表示を確認しました。その二杯をお願いします。少なめの方は私が受け取り、友人の普通の一杯と取り違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 各表示を確認し二杯を注文して、少なめを自分が受け取り普通量と区別すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I have checked the display. Please bring those two bowls. I will take the smaller one myself so that we do not mix it up with my friend's regular bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you checked both prices, order the two bowls, and will take the smaller one yourself to distinguish it from the regular one.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。麺量の違う単品を一杯ずつで、ご注文をお受けします。お出しする際にもお声掛けしますので、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Your order is one bowl on its own of each noodle quantity. We will also tell you which is which when we serve them, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 税の通知と用紙をお持ちですね。どの部分が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You have brought a tax notice and payment forms. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ封筒に二枚あり、両方の金額を足して払うのだと思いました。全部でいくらなのか、分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同封二枚を別請求と思って金額を足したため、総支払額が分からないと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: There were two sheets in the same envelope, and I thought I had to add both amounts and pay them. Now I am unsure how much I owe in total.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought the two enclosed sheets were separate bills and added the amounts, leaving you unsure of the total payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 金額だけで足さず、それぞれの見出しと対象を確認しましょう。こちらは総額、こちらは一回分という欄がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Rather than adding the numbers alone, let us check each heading and what it covers. Here there is a field for the total and another for one installment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二枚が別々の請求とは限らないのですね。総額の中にこの一回分がどう含まれるか、担当の方に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二枚が別請求と断定せず、総額と一回分の関係を担当に確認してほしいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So the two sheets are not necessarily separate bills. I would like the responsible staff member to check how this installment is included in the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume the sheets are separate bills and want the staff to check the relationship between the total and one installment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 対応する税の名称や期間も含めて担当が確認します。用紙の一部だけでなく、通知全体をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The responsible staff will also check the tax name and period. Have you brought the whole notice, rather than just part of a form?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 封筒の中の物は全部持ってきました。まだどの用紙も使っておらず、支払ったという控えもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同封物を全て持参し、用紙は未使用で支払いの控えもないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I brought everything that was in the envelope. I have not used any of the forms yet, and I have no proof that I have paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought all the enclosed materials, have not used the forms, and have no payment receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 用紙は未使用で、支払いの控えもないという状況ですね。金額以外に、相談したい事情はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So the forms are unused and you have no proof of payment. Apart from the amount, is there any circumstance you would like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 期限の意味も確認したいです。必要な額が分かってから、すぐ用意できない場合の相談先も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 期限の意味と、額が分かってもすぐ用意できない場合の相談先を尋ねたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I also want to confirm what the deadline means. After I know the required amount, I would like to ask whom to consult if I cannot prepare it immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to ask about the meaning of the deadline and whom to consult if you cannot immediately prepare the amount once it is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 額と期限を確認する質問、支払いについて事情を相談する質問として、担当へお伝えください。相談方法も含めて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please tell the responsible staff that you have questions about the amount and deadline and want to discuss your payment circumstances. Let us also check how to arrange that consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今は足し算した額で判断しません。通知と一回分の用紙を合わせて見てもらい、額と期限、相談先を順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 足した額で判断せず、通知と用紙を照合して額・期限・相談先を順に確認すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will not decide based on the amount I added up. I will have the notice and installment form checked together and confirm the amount, deadline, and consultation contact in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not rely on the added amount and will have the notice and form compared before checking the amount, deadline, and contact in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒の資料をそろえたまま、こちらの担当へお話しください。ご質問の三点を引き継いでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please speak to this responsible staff member with all the envelope's materials kept together. I will pass on your three questions and direct you there.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 包装済み商品の外観確認を担当していただきます。入室前の確認欄は、担当者と照合しましたか。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-01.translation: You will be checking the appearance of packaged products. Have you checked the pre-entry checklist with the responsible staff member?

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 更衣の確認は済みましたが、手袋の欄が空いています。交換した記憶だけで、自分で確認済みにしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 更衣確認は済んだが手袋欄が空いており、交換の記憶だけで確認済みにしてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The changing-clothes check is complete, but the glove field is blank. May I mark it confirmed myself just because I remember changing them?
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the clothing check is complete but the glove field is blank, and ask whether your memory of changing gloves is enough to mark it confirmed.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空欄の理由を入室担当に確かめましょう。記憶だけで記録を埋めず、確認を受けてから入室してください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us ask the entry staff why it is blank. Do not fill in the record from memory alone; please enter only after it has been checked.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入室担当に聞きます。実は今、手袋の指先に小さな破れも見つけました。まだ商品には触っていません。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入室担当へ確認すると伝え、手袋の破れと商品未接触を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will ask the entry staff. Actually, I have just found a small tear in a glove fingertip too. I have not touched any products yet.
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask the entry staff, and report both the glove tear and that you have not touched the products.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 触っていない段階で知らせていただけてよかったです。今は作業を始めず、破れと未確認の欄を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is good that you told us before touching anything. Do not begin work now; we will tell the responsible staff about the tear and the unchecked field.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 破れたことと商品に触っていないことを、両方報告します。交換後にどの欄へ記録するかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 破れと未接触を両方報告し、交換後の記録欄も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will report both that it is torn and that I have not touched the products. Please also tell me which field to record it in after changing the gloves.
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report both the tear and no product contact, and want to confirm the recording field after replacing the gloves.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録する場所は入室担当と一緒に確認しましょう。外観確認の見本を説明する前に、ほかにも気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check where to record it together with the entry staff. Before I explain the appearance-checking sample, is there anything else concerning you?

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見本の袋はきれいですが、窓の向こうに置いてある別の袋は口の部分が浮いて見えます。押さえて直してから確認するのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本と違い袋口が浮いて見える商品があり、押さえて直すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-08.translation: The sample bag looks fine, but another bag beyond the window appears lifted at its opening. Should I press it back into place before checking it?
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you should press closed a product bag whose opening appears lifted compared with the sample.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で直したり、良品と判断したりしないでください。どの商品かを責任者に示して、扱いの指示を受けます。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not repair it yourself or judge it to be a good product. Show the person in charge which product it is and obtain instructions on handling it.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋には手を加えず、口が浮いて見える場所を責任者に伝えます。手袋と記録の確認が済むまでは作業にも入りません。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋に手を加えず責任者へ示し、手袋と記録の確認まで作業を始めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not alter the bag; I will tell the person in charge where the opening appears lifted. I will not start work until the gloves and records have been checked either.
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not alter the bag, will show it to the person in charge, and will not start work until the gloves and records are checked.

DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では入室担当と責任者へ、それぞれの確認点を取り次ぎます。こちらで説明を受けるまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will pass the respective questions to the entry staff and the person in charge. Please wait here until you receive their explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: どちらの改札へ向かわれますか。大きなお荷物がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: Which ticket gate are you heading for? I see you have large luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 乗り換えの改札へ行きたいです。案内図のエレベーターに向かったのですが、前に工事の囲いがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 乗換改札へ行きたいが案内図のエレベーター前が工事囲いだったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: I want to reach the transfer gate. I went toward the elevator shown on the map, but there was construction fencing in front of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want the transfer gate but found construction fencing in front of the elevator on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: その設備は今使えません。囲いの中へは入らず、別の設備を使う経路を確認します。出発までの時間はおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: That facility cannot be used now. Do not go inside the fencing; we will check a route using another facility. Do you know how long you have until departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 切符ではあと二十分ほどです。遠回りになっても階段は使わずに行きたいのですが、間に合うと考えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 出発まで約二十分で階段を避けたいと伝え、遠回りでも間に合うと考えてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: According to my ticket, about twenty minutes. I would like to avoid stairs even if the route is longer, but may I assume I will make it in time?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that departure is in about twenty minutes and you want to avoid stairs, and ask whether you can assume the longer route will still be in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 混雑もあるので、間に合うとはお約束できません。別のエレベーターまで係員の案内が必要か、ここから問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: There may also be congestion, so we cannot promise you will make it. I will inquire from here whether you need a staff escort to the other elevator.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 荷物を持って行ったり来たりするのは難しいので、案内が決まるまでここで待ちたいです。座れる場所は近くにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 荷物を持って往復するのが難しく、案内が決まるまで待つ椅子を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: It is difficult to keep going back and forth with my luggage, so I would like to wait here until the directions are settled. Is there somewhere nearby to sit?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that going back and forth with luggage is difficult, and ask for a seat where you can wait until guidance is arranged.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この窓口横に椅子があります。案内の返答はそちらでお伝えできますが、荷物はご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: There are chairs beside this counter. We can give you the reply about directions there, but please keep your luggage with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 荷物は自分の横に置き、窓口横の椅子で待ちます。乗れなかった場合の切符の相談も、今の窓口でできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 荷物を自分で保持して窓口横で待ち、乗れなかった場合の切符の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: I will put the luggage beside me and wait on a chair next to the counter. Can I also ask at this counter about my ticket if I miss the train?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep your luggage with you and wait beside the counter, and ask where to discuss your ticket if you miss the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 切符の扱いは別の担当に確認します。移動の案内と切符の条件は分けてお伝えし、変更できるとはまだお約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: We will ask another staff member about how the ticket can be handled. We will explain the route guidance and ticket conditions separately, and cannot promise a change is possible yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: では先に移動の案内を待ち、切符については別の返答を聞きます。工事中の設備へ戻ったり、急いで階段を使ったりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintJa: 移動と切符の返答を分けて待ち、工事設備へ戻らず階段も急いで使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: Then I will first wait for the route guidance and hear the separate reply about my ticket. I will not return to the facility under construction or rush to use the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait separately for route and ticket replies, will not return to the construction area, and will not rush onto the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず移動担当へ連絡します。切符をお手元に置いて、横の椅子でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-02-001-SHAR.translation: Understood. I will contact the staff responsible for assistance first. Please keep your ticket at hand and wait on the chairs beside the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 贈り物でしょうか。こちらには大きな飾り布と、小さな手拭きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: Is this a gift? We have large decorative cloths and small hand towels here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 旅行のお土産を職場の四人に一つずつ渡したいです。飾る物より、普段使える手拭きがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 職場四人へ一つずつ渡す土産として、装飾布より実用の手拭きを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: I would like to give one travel souvenir each to four colleagues. Hand towels they can use daily seem better than something decorative.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want one souvenir for each of four colleagues and prefer practical hand towels to decorative cloths.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 小さな手拭きには濃い色と薄い色があります。見た目以外に重視されることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: The small hand towels come in dark and light colors. Is there anything important to you besides their appearance?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 毎日洗うと思うので、ほかの洗濯物と一緒に洗えるかが気になります。濃い色の表示を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 毎日ほかの物と洗えるかが気になり、濃色の洗濯表示を読んでもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: I think they will be washed every day, so I am concerned whether they can be washed with other laundry. Could you read the washing label for the dark-colored one?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are concerned about washing them daily with other laundry and ask the staff to read the dark color's washing label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: この濃い色には「初めは単独で洗う」とあります。薄い色は表示が違いますので、そちらも比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: The dark-colored one says “Wash separately at first.” The light color has a different label, so let us compare that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 使う人に洗い分けを頼まずに済むほうがよいです。薄い色を選ぶ前に、その注意書きも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 相手に単独洗いを頼みたくないと伝え、薄色の注意書きも選ぶ前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: I would prefer something that does not require asking the recipients to wash it separately. Before choosing the light color, I would also like to check its care instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not want to ask the recipients to wash it separately and want to check the light color's instructions before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 薄い色の表示には、洗濯ネットを使うことが書かれています。色ごとに注意は異なります。包装は一つにまとめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: The light-colored towel's label says to use a laundry net. The precautions differ by color. Shall we wrap them together?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 注意書きは四人ともに伝えたいので、一枚ずつ表示が残るように包めますか。四つをまとめた箱は要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 四人へ注意を伝えるため表示を残した個別包装を希望し、まとめ箱は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: I want to tell all four people about the care instructions, so can you wrap each one with its label left attached? I do not need a box holding all four.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Request individual wrapping with labels retained so you can tell all four people the precautions, and say in Japanese that you do not need a shared box.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 個別の袋に入れる形なら表示を付けたままにできます。袋代を含む合計をこちらでご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: We can leave the labels attached if we put them in individual bags. Please look here at the total including the bag charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 合計は予算内です。薄い色を四枚、表示付きの個別袋でお願いします。渡すときにネット使用の注意も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintJa: 合計が予算内と確認し、薄色四枚を表示付き個別袋で注文してネット使用を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: The total is within my budget. Please give me four light-colored towels, each in an individual bag with its label. I will also tell the recipients to use a laundry net.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the total fits your budget, order four light towels in separate labeled bags, and say that you will tell the recipients to use laundry nets.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.sourceJa: 四枚を別々の袋に入れ、表示がそろっているか確認してお渡しします。ご準備しますので少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-SATSUMASENDAI-03-001-SHAR.translation: I will put the four towels in separate bags, check that every label is attached, and hand them to you. Please wait a moment while I prepare them.
